import math

# Rural Electrification Administration values (in millions) from 1961-1970

n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")

# Theil index calculation

for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil Index = {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
